name: Face Detection
whenToRun: Run after adding new photos to /photos/archive. Step 1 of the face pipeline. Fast on small paths — limit to a year/month dir for incremental work. Use --force only to redo existing sidecars.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory or single file to scan.

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-extract even if sidecar already exists.

name: Face Clustering
description: Run DBSCAN on .faces.json embeddings, write clusters.json
whenToRun: Step 3 of the face pipeline. Run after Face Detection adds significant new faces. Reads all sidecars and rewrites clusters.json. Safe to re-run — assigned and skipped faces stay tracked in Neo4j and are filtered out of the unassigned view automatically.

params.name: eps
params.label: DBSCAN eps
params.hint: Max cosine distance within a cluster (0.0–1.0). Lower = stricter. 0.3 is current production setting.

params.name: min_samples
params.label: Min samples
params.hint: Minimum faces to form a cluster.

name: Build Face Index
description: Read all .faces.json sidecars, write embeddings.npy + faces_meta.json for similarity search
whenToRun: Step 2 of the face pipeline. Run after Face Detection (and before Clustering, if you want similarity search to find newly added faces). Always rebuilds the whole index — takes a few minutes on a full archive.

name: Object Detection
description: Run YOLO on archive, write .objects.json sidecars
whenToRun: Run after adding new photos to /photos/archive. Independent of the face pipeline. Limit path scope for incremental runs.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path
params.hint: Directory or single file to scan.

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-detect even if sidecar already exists.

name: CLIP Embeddings
description: Extract CLIP semantic embeddings, write .clip.json sidecars
whenToRun: Run after adding new photos. Powers natural-language image search. Independent of other pipelines.

params.name: path
params.label: Target path

params.name: force
params.label: Force re-run
params.hint: Re-extract even if sidecar already exists.

name: Scene Embeddings
description: Extract DINOv2 scene embeddings, write .scenes.json sidecars
whenToRun: Run after adding new photos. Used for visual-similarity search ("more like this"). Independent of other pipelines.

name: Archive Report
description: Scan archive metadata and regenerate report.json for Admin Overview
whenToRun: Run when the Admin Overview page numbers look stale (e.g. after a big import or after running other pipeline jobs). Takes a couple minutes; safe to run any time.
